claims.text: Avi Loeb's first Medium post on the UAP Science Advisory Council carries article:published_time 2026-06-13T16:20:50Z. His second post, 'More Details on the UAP Science Advisory Council', carries a byline of 16 June 2026; the 29 June 2026 date that has circulated is that post's republish timestamp, not its publication date.

edges.label: Chair, appointed June 2026
edges.note: DefenseScoop reports Loeb formed and leads the council; the Sol Foundation says it was announced by ODNI with FBI support. The two accounts differ on its legal character.

edges.label: Named for instrumentation and data collection
edges.note: The government's outside science body took its detector expertise from a self-funded civil expedition group, UAPx, rather than from a national laboratory.

edges.label: Named for data analysis and AI tools
edges.note: Cloete brings the Galileo Project detection-and-tracking pipeline published in the Journal of Astronomical Instrumentation in 2023.

b.label: PURSUE - Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters

edges.label: Council established following the PURSUE releases
edges.note: Loeb's Medium account references a government disclosure release date of 12 June 2026 immediately before describing his tasking; the council's formation follows the release programme rather than preceding it.
